question: Sohrai, Karam and Jawa festivals are celebrated in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Jharkhand__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sohrai is primarily a harvest festival celebrated in Jharkhand, marking the end of the harvesting season.
 
• The Karam festival is associated with fertility and is celebrated with great enthusiasm by the tribal communities of Jharkhand.
 
• Jawa is another festival celebrated in Jharkhand, symbolizing the sowing of new crops.
 
• These festivals reflect the rich cultural heritage and agrarian traditions of Jharkhand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jharkhand is a state in eastern India, known for its rich mineral resources, dense forests, and diverse cultural traditions.
 
• The state was formed on 15th November 2000, carved out of the southern part of Bihar.
 
• Jharkhand's culture is a blend of various indigenous tribal communities, making it rich in folk traditions, music, and dance.
 
• It is also home to several National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries, including Betla National Park and Hazaribagh Wildlife Sanctuary.
